author: Bulls231d
quote: Game is trying to squeeze its margins out of EVERYWHERE. Wouldn’t be surprised if their main goal was just highest grossing game. Yet again the price goes up. Remember when $50 felt like an insanely ridiculous price for a game…. It still is. I’m sure if they only sold it for $50-$60 they wouldn’t make enough money…. Right? Looks like an upgrade visually from GTA 5 obviously, it’s made 13 years later for a different gen… but it runs at 30 fps. People are comparing this to the original release for Red dead 2…. That was 8 years ago on a previous gen console. The wait is finally over.. it’s only on console at 30fps and has no real hard copy. It’s gonna take all your storage so you can’t play anything else (taking a note from cods book) hey it runs better on the newer ps5 pro model you should buy that…. Just kidding. The whole girlfriend sim housekeeper thing isn’t that bad like everyone’s making it, the lack of freedom to do what you want with this life you are building is. That’s what everyone was looking forward to, a realistic open world where you forge your own way and can do literally whatever you want when you want. If there was 15 girls you could pick from or pick none of them is more along what I think people would expect. Overall it’s not terrible for what the game is, it’s just a guided open world game that looks nice. What really drives this negative review is just the delay after delay to excite and bring hype around this game forever, probably realizing the product won’t live up to the manufactured hype so lets squeeze every penny from people while giving them something. Something with the critic reviews just feels off too. Some giving clear criticisms but still give 100. Others possibly not allowed to review for giving low reviews in the past. The game for the game is probably an 8 or has the potential to be improved and be that. The experience of gta 6 to this point has been largely negative. GTA has fanboys that will love anything they do as most things do, probably has a lot of people that were so excited, hyped it up so much, and waited so long they convince themselves this is exactly what they wanted, and a lot of people just hating to hate.

author: Bulls231d
quote: A game that was clearly ahead of its time as it still holds up today. I have played several major titles over the past years and truly believe this is the most fun I’ve had since Skyrim back in the day. It is not ann addictive stressful dopamine that makes you want to keep playing, rather actual enjoyment. Unless you’ve been playing this game every year the remake was done so well it feels like the first time playing. This game appeals to all not only to avid gamers. My girlfriend has never played a video game and upon watching me play decided she wanted to try her own play through. I wondered if she would try it and walk away but she comes back each night ready to progress. She is always asking what to do, getting briefly stuck but I can tell she is more satisfied when figuring out the answer rather than being given it. New features were added in little enough to be true to the original but enough that there is a fresh spark. The hall of fallen foes which gives you the chance to rematch higher level enemies is great and provides something to do after the game. This leads to the biggest pitfall of the game, it ends and leaves you thinking “so what do I do now” and if you’ve completed all side quests… there really isn’t much to do. Although I’d rather have an amazing game that ends fast than a long drawn out repetitive bloatware game, this does not change the fact the game will come to an end and leave you waiting almost 30 years for the remake.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
